request.subject: CITY:DINOSAUR:3

layers.text: Recolour every brown wooden part (the walls and posts of the hut on the left, the brown bands round the rib arch, the flag poles) to pale cream bone with cool grey shading, so that nothing is brown or wooden. Change nothing else: keep the giant cream rib arch, the horned skull, the bright red awning and roof, the bright red cone tents and flags, the dark stone posts, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
